en: This black-and-white postcard shows a historic European square with a prominent stone cathedral featuring a rose window and a Romanesque dome. In the foreground, there is a large ornately sculpted fountain topped with a statue of Neptune holding a trident. Behind the fountain, there are medieval-style stone buildings, one with battlements and a tower. Snow-capped mountains are visible in the background.
